dataset.name: Bounded cached structural-register and data-table index audit for WTC 1 Floors 93-99 readiness
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V10A. Read only the hashed cached structural archive index workbook and three cached PDF manifests. Identify exact Drawing Book 5, Drawing Book 6, office-floor/truss/slab, core, perimeter, connection and hat-truss document identifiers relevant to the V10A source gates. Produce a prioritized acquisition and transcription matrix without reading any target drawing payload, rescanning the source archive, reading work/official_sources, contacting an external party, assigning solver properties, running a structural solver or launching Blender.

target_groups.description: Core-column schedule and detail register target.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Column identifiers, floor ranges, splice elevations, section changes, steel grade references and drawing-to-detail cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, explicit Tower A/WTC 1 mapping, Floors 93-99 applicability, legible schedule cells and revision context.

target_groups.description: Drawing Book 5 beam schedules, types and stud details.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Book index, beam marks, WF sections, orientation, floor applicability, end details, stud/slab references and drawing cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, unambiguous Book 5 drawing number, Tower A/WTC 1 and Floors 93-99 mapping, legible section assignment and revision context.

target_groups.description: Drawing Book 6 connection, seat, temporary-elevation, louver and anchor register targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Connection marks, beam/column/truss seat assignments, bolts, welds, plates, anchors, elevations, applicable drawing ranges and revision context.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, connection mark joined to a physical member and floor, legible units and revision, without inferring a force-displacement law from geometry alone.

target_groups.description: Floor-system, floor-panel, floor-truss and design-calculation register targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Book/chapter index, floor bands, panel and truss marks, chord/web geometry, bridging, openings, tributary layout, design-calculation references and drawing cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, Tower A/WTC 1 mapping, Floors 93-99 applicability, member-level topology and legible dimensions with units and revision context.

target_groups.description: Concrete-reinforcing index, slab reinforcement and typical slab-section targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Slab thickness, reinforcement direction and quantity, deck/fireproofing context, openings, shear-transfer details, floor applicability and drawing cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, Tower A/WTC 1 and Floors 93-99 mapping, legible dimensions and reinforcement callouts with units and revision context.

target_groups.description: Penthouse/outrigger and upper connection-detail register targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Member topology, outrigger connections, compatibility path, floor/elevation mapping, section marks and revision context.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, Tower A/WTC 1 mapping, explicit member and connection topology and a separately source-supported load case before any credit.

target_groups.description: Truss detail and Book 11 index targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Truss marks, chord/web sections, joints, bridging, seats, panel points, dimensional geometry and Book 7 cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, unambiguous truss-to-floor and Tower A/WTC 1 mapping, units and revision context.

target_groups.description: Beam connection, support and girder-detail register targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Connection/support marks, bolts, welds, plates, seats, bearing details, member joins and cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, physical member/floor assignment, complete geometry and revision; constitutive behavior remains separately required.

target_groups.description: Beam, girder and bracing connection-detail targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Connection marks, bracing topology, plates, bolts, welds, supported members and cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, physical member/floor assignment and revision; no mechanical law inferred from detail geometry alone.

target_groups.transcription_scope: Panel/column marks, elevations, plate sections, splices, steel grades, tower assignment and drawing cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, verified Tower A/WTC 1 and Floors 93-99 mapping, legible schedule values with units and revision context.

target_groups.description: Exterior wall-tree schedule, index and detail targets.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Tree marks, column/spandrel topology, sections, joints, elevations, tower assignment and cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, Tower A/WTC 1 and Floors 93-99 applicability, units and revision context.

target_groups.description: Exterior wall-panel schedules, indexes and details.
target_groups.transcription_scope: Panel marks, column/spandrel plate geometry, splices, connections, elevations, Tower A/B labels and drawing cross-references.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, verified Tower A/WTC 1 mapping, Floors 93-99 applicability, legible units and revision context.

target_groups.transcription_scope: Detail identifiers, member references, elevations, connections and cross-references relevant to Floors 93-99.
target_groups.minimum_acceptance: Exact payload hash and provenance, verified WTC 1/floor/member applicability and revision context.

requirement_mapping.note: A Book 3 schedule may cross-check identifiers, but the archive index alone does not independently verify the V8Q identifier-to-member mapping.
Drawing families may contain dimensions or grids, but no coordinate system or as-built coordinate is accepted from an index row.
The register mentions temporary elevations and floor-system documents but supplies no floor elevation values.
Core-column schedules are the primary target for segment, splice and section continuity.
Book 5 is the primary cross-check for the official-model moment-subnetwork transcription and floor applicability.
Non-moment beams, slab strips and openings require joined Book 5, 7 and 8 transcription.
The exact Book 5 identifiers are located, but no member schedule cell is read in V10B.
Book 6 is primary; Books 12 and 13 are supplemental connection-detail families.
A design-drawing register cannot establish the physical 2001 damage state.
Book 7, 8 and 11 families are needed to replace generic single-truss geometry with floor-specific evidence.
Floor panel and truss detail families are the primary member-level topology targets.
WTCI-000502-L and WTCI-000733-L may contain design-calculation or correspondence context, but no numerical equivalent stiffness is accepted from the register.
Interior-seat assignment needs a joined connection-to-truss-to-floor transcription.
Exterior-seat assignment additionally requires the perimeter attachment cross-reference.
Design schedules may enable member mapping, but they do not independently validate the V8M official-model Floor 98 loads.
Books 1, 2, 4 and 20 are the primary perimeter section, panel, tree and splice targets.
Connection details may be transcribed later; physical event damage cannot be obtained from design drawings.
The transfer path requires a complete joined mapping across five drawing families.
Book 9 identifies the upper-truss detail family, but no cold or thermal load-path credit follows.
Design drawings alone do not define the truncated seven-floor model boundary loads, displacements or support stiffnesses.
Schedules may identify sections and material references; density, constitutive, rate and failure data remain separately required.
V9U stair records remain categorical hypotheses and are not promoted by this structural index audit.

known_index_quality_flags.detail: The Book 7 row ends with the register string '2 - C/2'; verify against the actual index before using it as a Book 7 endpoint.
The start string is '4 - B! - 300'; do not silently normalize the exclamation mark.
The structural archive register does not provide floor values for any of the 53 selected document rows.
The register uses Tower A/B labels but does not itself establish the WTC 1 mapping or revision authority.

next_iteration.objective: Preserve V8U through V10B and perform a strictly targeted, read-only identity check for only the nine P0 exact document identifiers predeclared by V10B. Use literal WTCI identifiers and a bounded file-count/byte gate rather than an archive-wide content rescan. If exact payloads are found, hash them and create working copies only inside wtc1_simulation_v8/input/v10c_structural_sources before transcribing index and locator fields; if not found, record each exact missing identifier. Do not contact an external party, assign solver properties, run a structural solver or launch Blender.
